svg.aria-label: An actual Marching Cubes cell and edge interpolation. Two triangles on the left are extracted by the native algorithm from eight sampled values. The right panel compares linear interpolation with the analytical field on one edge, explaining crossing positions of 0.6667 and 0.7071 mm. Corner colors identify threshold sides; axes retain physical length.
